adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts the reference payload construction changed from `credentialId: isCalendarType ? evt.destinationCalendar?.credentialId : result.credentialId` to `credentialId: isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : undefined` (and similarly later `credentialId: result.credentialId ?? undefined`). This means for non-calendar integrations (e.g., video/meeting references where `isCalendarType` is false) the created reference will no longer carry `result.credentialId` at all. Any downstream logic that relies on `bookingVideoReference.credentialId` to locate the correct credential for deletion/cleanup would now fail, consistent with the reported cancel-not-deleting-video issue.
